# HyperFrames Effects & Captions Gallery

> A curated, interactive gallery of HyperFrames effects, video transitions, animated captions, camera motion, WebGL shaders, and social-video UI effects. It preserves real previews, pinned source links, licenses, and actual integration status.

The catalog contains 445 canonical effects from 461 source versions: 74 official HyperFrames entries, 354 community entries, and 17 Atelier-authored local templates. Visual duplicates are grouped, and the HyperFrames implementation is preferred when one exists. A preview does not imply that a community effect is directly installable in HyperFrames.

## Primary resources

- [Live effects gallery](https://77654321.xyz/): Browse, search, filter, preview, favorite, and inspect effects.
- [Structured catalog JSON](https://77654321.xyz/data/gallery-effects.json): Machine-readable catalog used by the live gallery.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/genoooool/hyperframes-effects-gallery): Gallery source, pinned upstream files, previews, collection scripts, and deduplication rules.
- [English README](https://github.com/genoooool/hyperframes-effects-gallery/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, counts, integration states, local setup, and FAQ.
- [简体中文说明](https://github.com/genoooool/hyperframes-effects-gallery/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): Chinese project documentation.

## Catalog coverage

- 184 video transitions
- 58 animated captions
- 25 camera-motion effects
- 24 emphasis and callout effects
- 36 asset-presentation effects
- 37 rhythm and mood effects
- 67 information cues
- 14 texture and finish effects

## Source families

- [HyperFrames official catalog](https://hyperframes.heygen.com/catalog): Native registry blocks and components.
- [GL Transitions](https://github.com/gl-transitions/gl-transitions): GLSL transitions requiring a WebGL timeline host.
- [Remotion](https://www.remotion.dev/): React video components requiring a Remotion host or a deliberate HyperFrames port.
- [Source audit](https://github.com/genoooool/hyperframes-effects-gallery/blob/main/docs/ai/SOURCE_AUDIT.md): Included repositories, pinned revisions, exclusions, and adaptation notes.
- [Third-party notices](https://github.com/genoooool/hyperframes-effects-gallery/blob/main/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md): License and attribution boundaries.

- [Atelier authored templates](https://77654321.xyz/assets/atelier/knowledge/README.md): Independent parameterized HyperFrames examples, reference mapping, and local rendering instructions.

## Integration semantics

- HyperFrames native: official block/component; use its preserved install and source path.
- Atelier authored: local HyperFrames compositions, not registry items; use the provided source directory and variable file, never `hyperframes add`.
- Remotion: map React animation and frame timing into the target video host.
- GL Transition: provide from/to textures, progress, aspect ratio, parameters, and endpoint handling.
- Web effect: connect browser, SVG, or CSS animation timing to the video timeline.

When answering questions about an effect, preserve its original source family and do not claim that Remotion, GLSL, or Web entries support `npx hyperframes add` unless the catalog explicitly marks them as HyperFrames native.
